prices.item: Elastic self-managed Enterprise subscription, floor estimate (Vendr)
prices.notes: ESTIMATE, not a list price. Elastic publishes no self-managed price ('Contact sales for more pricing information about self-managed licensing', https://www.elastic.co/subscriptions). Vendr (page 'Last updated: February 2026'): 'Self-managed Enterprise subscriptions commonly start at $150,000+ annually and can exceed $500,000 for large-scale deployments.' The model uses the $150,000 floor, which favours ES.
